study_type: completed preliminary observational and developer-authored controlled study
frame: one public API page: 100 PEFT-tagged repositories ranked by downloads
primary_observational_target: availability and agreement of declared card base models and adapter loading dependencies
ground_truth_policy: controlled labels are assigned by construction; real disagreements are candidate discrepancies, not authenticated false lineage
controlled_suite: 36 unique authored scenarios; no independent annotators or blinded held-out evaluation
metrics: contradiction TP FP FN TN precision recall F1
inference: descriptive counts only; authored cases are not a random population sample
H1: artifact evidence adds contradiction detections in controlled cases; real-world generalization remains untested
H2: scope handling reduces controlled false warnings while reporting recall
H3: not tested: no independently annotated real-world exposure ground truth
